info.name: BuildHub API
info.description:
Every BuildHub endpoint, in an order that is safe to run top to bottom.

Folder 00 shows what the public may read without an account and folder 01 what it may not. Folder 02 registers three accounts, signs each in, and signs in as the seeded administrator, storing four tokens as collection variables; every later request carries the one belonging to whoever should be making it.

Folders 03-11 cover CRUD and the domain rules, and each includes the authorization failures: the wrong role (403), and the right role acting on somebody else's record (403). Folder 12 proves the delete guards refuse without removing anything. Folder 13 removes everything this run created, strictly leaf first, so no row is ever cascade-deleted. The seeded data is only ever read.

Set baseUrl if the app is not on http://localhost:5158. The seeded accounts all share the password Password123!.
